content.user_title: Build NFT Standards for Smart Contracts
content.value_statement: NFT projects need correct token standards, metadata, royalties, and marketplace compatibility. This skill provides Solidity patterns for ERC-721, ERC-1155, soulbound tokens, dynamic NFTs, royalties, and metadata.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use ERC-721 versus ERC-1155 token models.
Provides Solidity examples for minting, burning, metadata, and ownership checks.
Shows off-chain IPFS metadata and on-chain metadata structures.
Covers EIP-2981 royalty support and marketplace compatibility concerns.
Includes examples for soulbound tokens, dynamic NFTs, and ERC721A minting.
Lists related references and asset templates for deeper implementation work.
limitations: Does not run tests, deploy contracts, or verify bytecode.
Uses illustrative placeholder IPFS hashes and metadata values.
Does not cover chain-specific gas costs or current marketplace policy changes.
Requires a separate smart contract security review before production deployment.

use_cases.title: Launch a Collectible Contract
use_cases.description: Plan an ERC-721 collection with mint limits, token URIs, royalties, and marketplace metadata expectations.

use_cases.title: Plan Game Item Tokens
use_cases.description: Choose ERC-1155 for fungible and non-fungible game assets with supply tracking and batch minting.

use_cases.title: Review Metadata and Royalties
use_cases.description: Check NFT metadata, EIP-2981 royalties, and marketplace integration assumptions before release.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Token Standard
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the nft-standards skill to compare ERC-721 and ERC-1155 for my project: [collection details]. Recommend one standard and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Minting Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the nft-standards skill to outline minting rules for [project name]. Include supply limits, price, access control, and metadata handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design Metadata and Royalties
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the nft-standards skill to design metadata and royalty support for [NFT project]. Include IPFS, attributes, EIP-2981, and marketplace compatibility.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Advanced Mechanics
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the nft-standards skill to review a design with soulbound tokens, dynamic metadata, ERC721A minting, and marketplace constraints. Identify risks and tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: I need a standard for a game with swords, shields, and potions.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: Use ERC-1155 because it supports multiple token types in one contract. Track per-item supply and use batch minting for efficient distribution.

output_examples.input: I am launching a 10,000 item profile picture collection.
output_examples.output: Suggested direction: Use ERC-721 or ERC721A. Define max supply, per-wallet mint limits, base URI strategy, reveal process, and EIP-2981 royalties.

output_examples.input: I need non-transferable credentials as NFTs.
output_examples.output: Suggested direction: Use a soulbound ERC-721 pattern. Restrict transfers except minting and burning, and document recovery rules for users.

best_practices: Use OpenZeppelin contracts and pin metadata with a durable IPFS service.
Run a smart contract audit and test minting, burning, royalties, and transfer rules before launch.
Keep marketplace metadata compatible and document reveal, royalty, and supply rules.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy copied examples without adapting access control, supply checks, and testing.
Do not rely on mutable or unpinned metadata for permanent assets.
Do not assume every marketplace enforces royalties or supports the same metadata fields.

faq.question: What NFT standards does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers ERC-721, ERC-1155, metadata formats, EIP-2981 royalties, soulbound tokens, dynamic NFTs, and ERC721A minting patterns.

faq.question: Can it generate production-ready contracts?
faq.answer: It provides implementation guidance and examples. Production contracts still need testing, review, deployment planning, and security audit work.

faq.question: Does it support marketplace integration planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It discusses metadata expectations and compatibility topics for marketplaces such as OpenSea, LooksRare, Rarible, and Blur.

faq.question: Can it help choose between ERC-721 and ERC-1155?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare the standards based on asset uniqueness, batch minting, game items, collectibles, and marketplace goals.

faq.question: Does it cover metadata storage?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes off-chain IPFS metadata and on-chain metadata examples with attributes and generated media.

faq.question: Is this a security audit tool?
faq.answer: No. It is an implementation guide. Use dedicated smart contract auditing before handling real funds or assets.
